did: Built the phone half of the mock interview week's ladder. Each question now has its own pages, with four rungs at equal weight: read the answer, read it aloud, say it from cues, say it your way. Each take sent says which rung it was said on, and the first take of each question goes home on its own as soon as it's kept, so home keeps the cold first try. Recorded the owner's keep-first-and-latest ruling in the discard sites. My data now lists the middle takes home lets go at week close, with their words kept. Studio > Renders now says which scenes don't fit the frame when home holds a render for that.

calls.title: C558: Which takes home keeps of a question in an interview week
options: latest is the newest recording, and the take a send names is kept too
latest is the take the final send names, and only it
delete the middle takes' recordings at the week's deadline whether or not it was sent
calls.why: The owner's "latest" could mean the newest recording or the take sent; they differ when the owner says a question again after sending and never sends again. And whether a week with no final send ever loses its middle takes, since the proposal said "when the week closes".
calls.undo: Narrow let_go_retakes to keep only what the final send names besides the first.

calls.title: C561: Each page of the interview week as its own route
options: a route per page, one runtime in the layout
one route, the pages as steps of the bundle's own screen state
a route per page, each with its own runtime
calls.why: The owner asked for every artifact to be its own view; whether a view is a route (back works, a link can open it) or a screen inside one route is how the owner moves through the week.
calls.undo: Fold the child routes back into interview.tsx and render the pages from a page state in the runtime.

calls.title: C562: The rungs a week written before ready answers offers
options: the last two rungs, cues from what to cover
all four, the first two saying there is no ready answer this week
calls.why: A /1 week has no answer to read or read aloud; whether its absence shows is something the owner would see on screen.
calls.undo: Have stepsOf return ["own"] on a /1 week, or all four with the first two drawn as unavailable; and drop the `?? question.guidelines` fallback in SayTake (apps/www/src/components/jobs/interview/ladder.tsx).

calls.title: C563: Where the study page cites its sources
options: chips on work questions, the line on open ones
chips wherever a claim has a source
no chips, the sources behind a tap
calls.why: How an open question's study page says what its answer rests on, when it rests on a shape rather than on the work.
calls.undo: Show Sources whenever a part has sources, and reword study.open.

calls.title: C565: How My data shows a middle take home let go
options: keep the row, say when it went and what stays; a copy on this phone still plays
keep the row, and offer no Play even where this phone holds a copy
drop the row from the list, leaving only its receipt on the Deleted page
calls.why: How My data shows a recording home let go by rule rather than by the owner's own delete, and whether the phone's own copy still plays once home's is gone.
calls.undo: Drop the wentAt line and its branch in device-my-data.tsx and play from home only (playsFrom ignoring the phone's copy for such a note); on the Deleted page drop wentAtClose's branch.

calls.title: C566: How the conveyor sets aside a render whose scenes don't fit
options: its own aside, "Spilled over the pan"
"Too big for the oven", as a too-long render is
calls.why: The conveyor's pizza names are the owner's (#2876, C139); a render whose scenes overflow their frame was neither too long nor too large, and nothing went wrong while making it, so none of the names C502 chose says what happened.
calls.undo: In conveyor.ts, have failedAside return "tooBigForOven" (or "burnt") for an overflow and drop the spilledOver aside.
